documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Notice Of Board Meeting

TWENTY-FIRST ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING ('AGM') OF THE MEMBERS OF SIRCA PAINTS INDIA LIMITED WILL BE HELD ON TUESDAY, AUGUST 11, 2026 AT 12:30 P.M. IST THROUGH VIDEO CONFERENCING ('VC') / OTHER AUDIO-VISUAL MEANS ('OAVM')

analysis.summary: Sirca Paints reported strong standalone financial performance for Q4 FY26 and the full year FY26, driven by a differentiated portfolio, premium positioning, and deeper market penetration. Management highlighted ongoing transitions including localizing production for acrylic and polyester systems, expanding distribution into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities as well as the West and South, and scaling the acquired Wembley brand. Despite temporary raw material price volatility and supply chain headwinds, the company implemented price hikes and expects sustainable revenue growth and stable EBITDA margins ahead. Sirca Paints India Limited reported strong financial performance for Q4 and FY26, with revenue increasing by 33.07% to ₹134.29 crore in Q4 and 31.79% to ₹492.48 crore for the full year. Management highlighted the successful integration of the newly acquired Wembley brand and the full operational status of the new dedicated Wembley manufacturing facility.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth of 25-30% on a CAGR basis for the upcoming year.
guidance.quote: So, you know, considering the current situation and, you know, considering companies' expansion into product lines and also, you know, deeper penetration into newer cities, including south and west, we are looking at a growth of almost 25-30% based on, you know, CAGR growth.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are projected to stay within the range of 19-21%.
guidance.quote: So, you know. The EBITDA margin should stay, you know, in the range of 19-21%.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving 1,000 crores in revenue in three years from now.
Exports under the Wembley Valentino brand are expected to contribute near 3-4% to revenues.
guidance.quote: The export will become, you know,A part of contributor in the revenue, if not 5% we are expecting, should be near 3-4%.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for polyurethane and product shifts towards polyurethane technology are occurring very rapidly in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: the demand for the polyurethane and the product shift from a certain product category to polyurethane technology is happening very fast in the market, which will, you know, Sirca, being as an established player in the polyurethane category, will give us a lot more opportunity

demand_outlook.claim: Local production of furniture in India is expected to grow aggressively for the next 3 to 5 years following the implementation of BIS.
demand_outlook.quote: We are expecting the local production of furniture in India to grow very aggressively for next 3 to 5 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q4 FY26 delivered resilient growth despite a soft demand environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Q4 FY26 delivered resilient growth despite a soft demand environment, supported by acrylic and advanced coating systems, wider distribution reach, and stronger architect, designer and institutional engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that near-term demand remained moderate, but the long-term structural outlook stays positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Near-term demand remained moderate, but the long-term structural outlook stays positive — driven by premiumisation, urbanisation, renovation demand, organised furniture growth and rising preference for branded, technologically advanced coatings.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Wembley manufacturing facility is now fully operational, combining multiple production lines into a single integrated setup.
capex_expansion.quote: The new Wembley manufacturing facility is now fully operational, consolidating multiple production lines into one integrated setup — improving efficiency, quality consistency and cost economics.

capex_expansion.claim: For FY27, the company expects a capex of 5 to 6 crores to enhance the production of acrylic products.
capex_expansion.quote: We are only expecting a 5 to 6 odd crore CAPEX, which we will do to enhance our production of the Acrylic products, which we have, just completed the know-how.

margins_costs.claim: The company is experiencing short-term margin pressure because of higher and volatile raw material prices linked to crude oil.
margins_costs.quote: See, so we are, you know, experiencing a short-term margin pressure because the raw material situation, as you rightly said, because of the global situation and, you know, crude oil, because most of the products that we use our crude link, are on higher side and, you know, highly volatile

margins_costs.claim: Sirca implemented a 5% price increase in April and another 5% price increase effective immediately.
margins_costs.quote: Yeah, so at the Sirca level, we have taken a price increase of 5%, which was implemented from first week of April, and another price increase of, again, a 5%, which has been implemented from today.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability was protected through calibrated pricing, sourcing optimisation, product-mix improvements and tighter operational controls despite volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Despite geopolitical, currency and crude-linked raw material volatility, profitability was protected through calibrated pricing, sourcing optimisation, product-mix improvements and tighter operational controls — supporting sustainable margins over the medium term.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the core Sirca unit is expected to be fully utilized in a single shift by the end of the year.
orders_capacity.quote: so we are expecting that by the end of this year, the capacities will be, you know, utilized, fully in single shift of the Unit 1, which is the Sirca… core Sirca unit.

orders_capacity.claim: Sirca serves an OEM client base of over 900 clients.
orders_capacity.quote: OEM VENDOR MARKET LEADER SOLE & EXCLUSIVE Preferred OEM Vendor Among the Top 3 Premium LICENSEE on its way to become a wood coating brand in India of Globally established Dominating Retail Brand Market Leader in North India ‘Sirca’ brand for India

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced major shortages of nitrocellulose cotton (NC cotton) from its global supplier Nitrex due to diversion of supply to defense.
risks_headwinds.quote: Which is… which was, you know, which actually made us, you know, lost revenue of about 4 to 5 odd crores, you know, in the month of March, so we almost lost orders of 4 to 5 crores in March from Wembley.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted geopolitical, currency and crude-linked raw material volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite geopolitical, currency and crude-linked raw material volatility, profitability was protected through calibrated pricing, sourcing optimisation, product-mix improvements and tighter operational controls — supporting sustainable margins over the medium term.

management_commitments.claim: Production of acrylic systems and commercial trials are underway with production expected to commence in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Formula transfers for acrylic and polyester systems are complete; commercial trials are underway with production expected to commence in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: UV technology transfer is on track for Q1 to deepen localization.
management_commitments.quote: UV technology transfer is also on track for Q1 — deepening localization and supporting long-term margins.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve 1,000 crores in revenue in three years from now.
Commercial trials for acrylic, polyester, and selected UV systems are underway, with production expected to commence in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Significant progress on the formula transfer initiative for acrylic, polyester and selected UV systems — acrylic and polyester transfers completed, commercial trials underway, with production expected to commence in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Formula transfer for selected UV technology products is expected to complete within Q1.
management_commitments.quote: Formula transfer for selected UV technology products progressing as planned, expected to complete within Q1 — strengthening localisation, supply-chain efficiencies and long-term margin through deeper manufacturing integration.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
